## Before review

From [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md):

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Tests show the change
- [ ] No file over 400 lines
- [ ] No import of a path inside another package, and no cycle
- [ ] Every user-facing string is in the catalogue
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header
